continuity: Ize Press English novel Volume 1 selected-witness continuity
work_or_witness: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint (novel), Vol. 1, Ize Press English edition
description: An ordinary office worker whose favorite online novel is so obscure that he is its sole reader. When the train's passengers receive an unavoidable fatal order and the events of that story intrude into reality, he remains calm because he knows how the plot is supposed to unfold.

roles_and_vocations.note: Directly described by Ize Press; no socioeconomic class or real-world employment condition is inferred.

narrative_archetypes.term: sole reader of an obscure online novel
narrative_archetypes.note: Directly described by Ize Press and retained as a fiction-within-fiction premise, not a generic ability.
Ize Press says Dokja knows how the events will play out; boundaries and later consequences are not asserted.

canon_status: Synopsis-level character in the selected Ize Press English novel Volume 1 witness.

supports: Dokja Kim is an office worker and the sole reader of an obscure online novel.
He recognizes the train, passengers, creature, and scenario as elements from the novel and uses that foreknowledge to survive.

comparison_cautions: The selected English source presents the name as Dokja Kim and does not provide Korean script or an alternate-name order; neither is inferred.
Reader/protagonist framing is source-specific fiction-within-fiction, not omniscience, an actual System power, or a real-world epistemic claim.
No webtoon/manhwa, anime, game, later-volume, side-story, or adaptation characterization is imported.
